moveSpeed.title: Move Speed
moveSpeed.description: Horizontal speed in units per second

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.description: How quickly the character reaches target speed (higher = snappier)

groundCheckDistance.title: Ground Check Distance
groundCheckDistance.description: Extra distance below the capsule that still counts as grounded

cameraEntity.title: Camera (optional)
cameraEntity.description: If set, movement is relative to where this camera faces

modelEntity.title: Model (optional)
modelEntity.description: Child entity holding the visible model; it is rotated to face the move direction

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Degrees of rotation per pixel of mouse movement

maxPitch.title: Max Pitch
maxPitch.description: How far up/down you can look, in degrees

spriteEntity.title: Sprite Entity
spriteEntity.description: Child entity with the Render component (Plane)
